name: COMP_050
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (86%)** · Confident · Careful review
Whole-slide pooling is confident for Benign [F1], but tier-1 frozen-section margins [F7] and region 1 show focal risk.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 86%, Normal 8%, InSitu 5%, Invasive 1% | Favors Benign; 1% invasive risk |
| Conformal set | {Benign} (90% test coverage; CI 76%–98%) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 82% OOD, 12/12 regions [F6] | Clean input; moderately high OOD |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | True (same top class) | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 1/5 Benign (20%), 4/5 Normal (91%–92%) [F5] | Neighbors mostly Normal, not Benign |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 8, 9, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.84 contribution) [F2], but 0/20 AI spot-check · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 3) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical slide score (-0.48 contribution), though positive in region 3 [F3] · Validated
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 8, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.30 contribution) in lower regions supports non-invasive read [F4] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 8, 9, 10) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical text-only score (-0.29 contribution); caption check failed · Weak
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 0, 1) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score (+0.15 contribution), differs from BACH_0076; 3/20 spot-check · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; removing top-risk regions drops invasive probability more than random removal (+0.011, 95% CI 0.002–0.020, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unverified (deletion 95% CI -0.009–0.006 includes 0); leans on Unreliable normal lobules (0/20) and necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Benign lower regions (4–11) mask focal malignancy at positive superior/lateral margins (215 µm each) or region 1 (53% risk).
- The tissue is actually Normal, matching 4 of 5 nearest reference cases (91%–92% similarity) rather than Benign.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 3**: Inspect superior and lateral margins (215 µm each) and focal risk hotspots (53%, 12%).
2. **Region 0**: Check for duct-confined atypia, nuclear pleomorphism, or necrosis differing from Normal match BACH_0076.
3. **Regions 8, 9, 11**: Verify two-layered lobules and benign stroma/fat driving the non-invasive classification.
